tshig bdun sogs gsol 'debs sngon 'gros/ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams: mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dza: zhes skyabs yul gsal btab la/ skyabs 'gro ni/ na mo: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sku: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i gsung: chos sku longs sku sprul sku 'dus pa'i thugs: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can ma lus pa: byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ ho: sems bskyed 'gro ba bdag gzhan kun don du: gang 'dul thabs kyis gdul dka' 'dul mdzad pa'i: bla ma yi dam nor lha bsgrubs nas ni: mtha' yas 'gro ba sgrol bar sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ yan lag brgyad pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo: mchog gsum bsten pa'i zhing gyur la: gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs: nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi: phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos: ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang: dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med: rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do: bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la: dag pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo: tshe rabs bgrangs pa'i las rnams kun: bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo: lan gsum gyis tshogs gsag / sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig: sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog: bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing: chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa/ skyabs yul rnams rang la thim par mos/ gter gzhung sgrub thabs 'dod rgu'i char 'beb gzhi bgegs la gtor ma bsngo ba sogs dkyus bzhin no/// /
